learningObjectives: Explain why neural signalling is metabolically expensive.
Describe neurovascular coupling and glial metabolic support.
Identify consequences of oxygen or glucose interruption.
Avoid simplistic interpretations of fatigue and cognition.

anatomy.label: Cerebral microvasculature
anatomy.detail: Capillary flow adjusts with local neural demand.
anatomy.clinical: Impaired coupling can reduce network efficiency.

anatomy.label: Astrocytic endfeet
anatomy.detail: Astrocytes sense activity and distribute substrates.

anatomy.label: Mitochondria
anatomy.detail: Oxidative phosphorylation powers pumps and synaptic processes.
anatomy.clinical: Failure produces fatigue, seizures or neurodegeneration.

anatomy.label: Metabolic clearance
anatomy.detail: Blood flow and glial systems support clearance.

interaction.title: Explore Brain Energy Metabolism
interaction.instruction: Select a component, then run the sequence.

stages.label: Demand
stages.text: Neural activity increases local energy requirements.

stages.label: Signal
stages.text: Cells and vessels communicate metabolic need.

stages.label: Deliver
stages.text: Blood flow supplies oxygen and glucose.

stages.label: Convert
stages.text: Mitochondria and glycolytic pathways generate ATP.

stages.label: Restore
stages.text: Pumps reset ion gradients and clearance removes by-products.

quizBank.question: Most neural ATP is used substantially for:
quizBank.explanation: Ion pumping and synaptic signalling dominate the energy budget.

quizBank.question: Neurovascular coupling means:
options: Local activity changes local blood flow
All brain regions receive fixed flow
quizBank.explanation: Active tissue recruits increased perfusion and substrate delivery.

quizBank.question: Why is hypoglycaemia dangerous to the brain?
options: The brain has limited fuel reserves
quizBank.explanation: Continuous substrate delivery is needed for neural function.

quizBank.question: Astrocytes contribute by:
options: Coordinating metabolic support and vascular responses
quizBank.explanation: Astrocytes link synaptic activity, substrates and local vessels.

quizBank.question: A sound clinical inference is:
options: Cognitive fatigue has multiple possible mechanisms
Blood flow is irrelevant to function
quizBank.explanation: Symptoms require differential assessment rather than single-cause assumptions.

reviewPrompts: Most neural ATP is used substantially for:
The brain stores little fuel. Continuous supply and precise regulation matter more than simple “brain energy” slogans.

references.citation: Magistretti PJ, Allaman I. A cellular perspective on brain energy metabolism and functional imaging. Neuron. 2015;86:883–901.

Kandel ER et al. Principles of Neural Science. 6th ed. McGraw-Hill; 2021.
